canon_hooks.native_excerpt: "It breaks my heart to leave this place, but we cannot stay here. The sanctuary was protected by the secrecy of its location. But now that the demons know about the temple, this is no longer a place of refuge. I will lead the survivors somewhere safe — but I cherish the hope that we will return. Someday, our waterfalls will sing again..."
